description: Capabilities for the Android (and iOS, if ever built) shell. Scoped to the app's own private storage instead of $DOCUMENT, since Android's scoped-storage rules mean a bare $DOCUMENT/TurfApp/** scope (used in default.json for desktop) does not behave the same way here. 'platforms' is now set to ['android'] — Tauri's own docs (Capabilities for Different Windows and Platforms) confirm the enum is lowercase ('linux', 'windows', 'macos', 'android', 'ios'), which was the uncertainty blocking this before (see docs/android-port-notes.md). Re-verify this scopes correctly once `tauri android init` has actually been run and `gen/schemas/mobile-schema.json` exists to check against.
